description: Example ontology-sources.json — copy to ontology-sources.json and adjust paths. The default paths point at the local ontology cache materialized by `pnpm run fetch:ontology` from the pin in ontology-package.json. Add a second source pointing at .ontology/imports to opt in to the foundation vocabularies (see apps/docs/ontology.md).
